text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr decides to enter the long-distance Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seeks to compete with Tokai Teio, who has made a successful comeback after suffering consecutive injuries.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Teio says that although she won't be able to run like she used to, she'll win anyway. And that's because she's going to surpass the Emperor, as the miraculous and undefeated Monarch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zephyr senses that Teio is stronger now than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She must breathe in that miracle and become the ultimate wind. The clash both racers have long anticipated is finally about to begin.
